introduction: Tennessee unemployment uses Unemployment Claimant e-Services through Jobs4TN. Weekly certifications and required work-search activities begin while the claim is being decided.
description: Tennessee unemployment uses Unemployment Claimant e-Services through Jobs4TN. Weekly certifications and required work-search activities begin while the claim is being decided.

sections.who: The agency assesses covered earnings, separation circumstances and ability, availability and search for work. Reduced hours can also be reviewed.
sections.get: Approved eligible weeks provide temporary payments. A monetary determination estimates possible benefits and is not an approval.
sections.docs:
• Identity and employment records.
  • Employer and separation details.
  • Weekly earnings and search records.
sections.apply:
1. Open claimant e-Services

    Use Jobs4TN’s File for Unemployment route.

  2. Answer fact-finding

    Check the Summary screen and Action Center for questionnaires.

  3. Certify weekly

    Report the prior week’s circumstances and the state’s required work-search activities.
sections.after: Keep certifying while awaiting the result and monitor nonmonetary decisions. Read notices about waiting-week and payment arrangements.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Current e-Services intake, Weekly filing and determination rules. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: No. The agency expressly distinguishes the possible amount from an eligibility decision.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
